title: Croatian Fried Fritters
description: A crispy and savory fried snack originating from Croatia. Enjoy as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C (350°F).
In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, and fritter seasoning.
In a separate bowl, whisk together melted butter, egg, and chopped peanuts (if using).
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough until it is smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat the oil in the frying pan and carefully place a few fritters into the oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Serve with a side of your favorite dipping sauce, if desired.
